description_en: Creates an environment in a project and optionally deploys the environment automatically based on a template. Services are deployed to a specified environment. An environment can be associated with a branch of a code repository or a project template. An environment can also have an infrastructure stack that is shared by all services in the environment
description_zh:
创建项目下的环境，并可选地根据模板自动部署该环境。
服务会部署到指定的环境中，环境可以绑定代码仓库的某个分支或者某个项目模板。环境还可以设置基础设施堆栈，被环境下的所有服务所共享
